resolved_summary_v1_findings.label: uniform A0: coarse minus fine; sensitivity only

review_method: Read ordinary NPZ/JSON only; no FE solve and no rerun of production or audit scripts.

Verify every selected run completion, every stage completion, every accepted NPZ hash, little-endian two-array identity, index/result identity, inherited source evidence/audit chain, and exact activation projection bytes.

Reevaluate every recorded gate comparison with Decimal; require complete per-phase check-name sets; independently recompute all six production-vs-HP80 and HP80-vs-HP120 component vector norms from raw saved arrays with the frozen scales.

Reconstruct exact physical vertices as Fraction(coords)+Fraction(lift)+Fraction(fluctuation), verify all cells strict convexity/positive area, and recompute solid/rectangle intersection by vertex/edge-point enumeration plus convex hull; background medium excluded only from overlap.
Inspect all observed states and summary comparison points; retain aborted-run prefix without admitting its path; inspect original 50/80 failures and explicit 80/120 amendment.
Hash every consumed source/helper/evidence file and check sources unchanged at end.
limits: This independently verifies saved provenance, numerical gate arithmetic, component comparisons, and geometry. It does not rerun the Decimal constitutive reference or establish a general-contact/FE truth/convergence result.

Summary_v1 retained three physically uninterpretable ratios from nominal-zero reference residues. Summary_v2 explicitly sets all 12 nominal-zero-reference ratios to null, preserves the raw force and absolute difference, and is the final reviewed summary.

Mesh sensitivity includes eight exactly shared accepted TMC bisection coordinates in addition to original requested targets. These are valid common accepted states, not additional independent experiments.
